sources.title: Gulf News, Philippine passport fee may rise to ₱1,500 — but not yet (last updated 21 September 2026)
sources.said: How much is a Philippine passport now? The current regular passport processing fee is ₱950 . Applicants who choose expedited processing pay ₱1,200 . The DFA's official passport website lists these as the current fees for both new applications and renewals.
